destination.summary: Keeps black-hole model building, more direct quantum calculations and the proposed emergence of weak-gravity behavior distinguishable.

systems: Static, rotating and collapsing black-hole settings
Charged black holes with running gravitational and electromagnetic couplings
targets: Whether weak-gravity behavior follows in a specified model
regimes: Leading small-running corrections in the charged-black-hole proposal
assumptions: A model-dependent extremality correction does not establish a universal Weak Gravity Conjecture.
conventions: RG improvement and first-principles calculations are different evidential routes.
includes: Ambiguities and improvements in model construction
Arguments extending beyond a single UV framework
excludes: Universal singularity resolution or weak-gravity claims from the supplied abstracts
